findings.fact: The replacement abandons a proven nine-trick club route and spends the entries needed to use it.
findings.explanation: Both defenders followed to CA and CK, leaving only CJ outstanding. A club to North's CQ necessarily removes CJ; North can return a heart to HA, allowing South to cash the two remaining clubs. Together with DK, HA, HK and SA, this supplies nine total tricks. Cashing those side winners first removes South's entries after CQ, while the stated major-suit development supplies no concrete replacement route.
